concept: Messages between actors in time: lanes with hairline rails, solid arrows for a message and dashed for a reply, read aloud step by step.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a sequence diagram as a static image with tiny labels
default_to_avoid.kind: sequence diagram, message flow, swimlane timeline
default_to_avoid.why_not: an image cannot be read by a screen reader or scrolled on a phone; Pane draws it as a list with each step spoken

derivation.consequence: opaque pairs are computed, glass pairs are measured
derivation.form: rails are hairlines and arrows wear the text tones, never a series colour

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: a message is a solid arrow and a reply a dashed one, so the kind reads by shape

derivation.consequence: labels and names exist for assistive tech even when hidden visually
derivation.form: each step is a list item that says who, to whom and what

options: A lanes with a spoken list
variants.picked: A lanes with a spoken list
variants.reason: A keeps the picture and the words (P6). B shuts out screen readers. C loses who talks to whom at a glance.

root.why: the diagram stacks under its caption so the name is read first

caption.why: the caption is label size in the primary tone

scroll.why: the lanes scroll sideways on a narrow screen instead of squeezing

grid.why: one grid column per lane so every arrow lines up

lanes.why: the actor heads sit in one row over their lanes

lane.why: a lane is one column at the lane width

actor.why: an actor head is a small level-2 pane with its edge

steps.why: the steps stack at the row height so arrows sit one under another in time order

step.why: a step spans from its sender lane to its receiver lane

time.why: the time is caption size in the tertiary tone

arrow.why: a message is a solid line ending in a head

back.why: a step going back to an earlier lane turns its head round

reply.why: a reply is dashed in the secondary tone

text.why: the message rides above its arrow at caption size

self.why: a message to itself loops back into the same lane

note.why: a note is a quiet pane on its lane

focus-visible.why: the scroll area shows the focus ring when reached by keyboard

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours arrows and rails are drawn in the text colour
